title: My Son Forged A $650K Sale Of My Popcorn Shop And Gave Me $5K. So I Voided The Deal
description: I poured my $120,000 nursing pension into a gourmet popcorn shop with my son, notarizing a 50/50 partnership. He forged a dissolution, sold the recipes and brand for $650,000, and gave me a $5,000 'family bonus'. I found our original agreement in an old holiday tin, voided the sale, and now he stirs two-hundred-pound kettles in a shirt that says 'Pop Goes the Lies' while every bag prints his perjury docket. #FamilyBetrayal #KernelOfDeceit #PopcornRevenge
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY POPCORN SHOP NOW HE STIRS MY KETTLES
pinned_comment: What would you do if your son poured your $120,000 nursing pension into a popcorn shop, sold it for $650K, and handed you a $5,000 'family bonus'? Share your story in the comments.
